professionalSummary: Project manager on a bank's wealth platform onboarding programme for three years, running the onboarding projects for two regions under the bank's delivery framework with their migration plans and adviser training schedules. (src_d136d889f76f)
experienceHighlights: Steered the two regions' senior advisers through the migration under the programme's adviser engagement plan; the engagement log records the fifty-eight adviser objections raised, the resolution of each, and the two regions' migration completed with every adviser onboarded on schedule. (src_ef52198a7672)

Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of wealth change and managed the dependencies with the platform vendor and adviser operations through the framework's dependency log. (src_5fd469169560)

Prepared the migration readiness review for each migration wave; the go-ahead was the regional wealth director's, recorded on the review together with which checks were mine and which were adviser operations'. (src_9c3b1303c77a)
Wrote the closure report for each region with the project boundary statement and the client migration evidence accepted by the programme office. (src_4922daf7a113)
